model_note: claude-opus-5-5, tier 2 report-only (LINT-07); findings are advisory and never block on their own (LINT-03). Run inline in an attended session, not by a separate wf-review agent.

resolved_in_review.finding: gofmt -w had re-indented an untouched line in safeDialContext.

notes_for_signoff.note: The diff follows the design's Decision 5, which Jeff confirmed (a1): /ca.crl is served unrecorded, like /ca.pem. RELAY-02's text says every byte sent to the build is recorded and names no exception for relay trust material. /ca.pem already relied on that unstated exception. Sign-off may want RELAY-02 to say so (a FLOW-14 rule change; not made here). TestRelayServesCACRL asserts the no-record behaviour and was mutation-checked: with recordServed added, it fails.

Relay change: the design's Security note covers the new endpoint, key use and trust posture. The endpoint takes no input and serves fixed bytes; the POST upload fallback is shadowed for /ca.crl only (tested).
The CA key signs the CRL in memory inside generateCA; nothing is persisted.
m6-validate-windows-hyperv (blocking) is still to run: tier 0 cannot exercise Schannel.
